006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.configuration.AbstractConfigurationFeature;
009
010import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
011
012/**
013 * A set of configurable features that adjust Metaschema constraint validation
014 * behavior.
015 *
016 * @param <V>
017 *          the Java type of the configuration value
018 */
019public final class ValidationFeature<V>
020    extends AbstractConfigurationFeature<V> {
021  /**
022   * If enabled, generate findings for passing constraints.
023   */
024  @NonNull
025  public static final ValidationFeature<Boolean> VALIDATE_GENERATE_PASS_FINDINGS
026      = new ValidationFeature<>("include-pass-findings", Boolean.class, false);
027  /**
028   * If enabled, throw an exception when an error occurs.
029   */
030  @NonNull
031  public static final ValidationFeature<Boolean> THROW_EXCEPTION_ON_ERROR
032      = new ValidationFeature<>("throw-exception-on-error", Boolean.class, false);
033
034  private ValidationFeature(
035      @NonNull String name,
036      @NonNull Class<V> valueClass,
037      @NonNull V defaultValue) {
038    super(name, valueClass, defaultValue);
039  }
040}
